description.value:
All the world is your stage, and your fellows and foes its stars. They may not know yet what parts they’ll play, but come time for the curtains to fall you will have shown them.

While you are within 60 feet of a creature that can hear you, you can target it with the following abilities:


Glorify

Talking up their achievements or potential, you give your ally a much needed confidence boost.

Spend 1 @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.abilities.ZVH8L715PTWTQLSE]{Immersion} as a minor action, the target becomes @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.conditions.ZOBZ8V2YME5YOYZR]{Lionized} for 10 minutes.


Vilify

Singling out a foe, you confront them on their foul deeds or harp on the flaw that will become their downfall.

Spend 1 @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.abilities.ZVH8L715PTWTQLSE]{Immersion} as a minor action, the target becomes @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.conditions.WHN3T2G6R8HUKOQX]{Villainized} for 1 minute.


Catharsis

The audience delights in seeing a villain getting what they deserve. Let them savor the moment a little longer.

As a reaction to a creature taking damage from the @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.conditions.WHN3T2G6R8HUKOQX]{Villainized} condition, immediately restore its ability to take damage from the condition.
